item.endragonupgrade.dragon_shot.desc: High-damage arrow. Misses leave a lingering dragon-breath cloud.
item.endragonupgrade.chain_of_god.desc: Right-click an empowered Ender Dragon to freeze it in place for 10 seconds.
advancement.endragonupgrade.invincible.d: You defeated the toughest, deadliest creature in Minecraft. Keep it up!
endragonupgrade.menu.title: Empower the Ender Dragon
endragonupgrade.menu.subtitle: Pick a difficulty
endragonupgrade.menu.very_hard.desc: 4 stages, 1200 HP. Twice as fast, radial dragon-novas and fire pillars. Only for the strongest.
endragonupgrade.menu.extreme.desc: 6 stages, 2000 HP. Three times harder than VERY HARD. Fire rain, shadow clones, merciless aura.
